Noah Li: Heads up team — planning a 72h microtrial to compare a $0.005 per-request 'priority surcharge' vs a small uplift to per-token price. Need quick decisions on grandfathering for legacy invoices.
Priya Desai: Exempt negotiated contracts. For others we should auto-credit any overage on the first invoice and include a clear billing note.
Jordan Meyers: Marketplace-sourced customers need vendor opt-in. Exclude them from the microtrial.
billing-bot: Export: /exports/pricing/priority-micro-2017000000.csv (320 rows)
Noah Li: Proposal: cohort = 3% self-serve monthly active, window = 72h, rollback if support ticket delta >0.4% or revenue delta >25%.
Priya Desai: I'll prepare the billing-note text: "Priority surcharge applied as part of a short trial. Any first-cycle delta will be credited." Share for legal review.
Jordan Meyers: Ops - please add tag: pricing_expt_priority_apr2026 and ensure separate invoice line for trial customers.
Noah Li: Thanks — aiming for signoff by Fri EOD to launch Mon. Ping me if you see contract exceptions. :rocket:
